title: ID0429031-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S8 170003980] Terminal Communication Timeout
description:
Reported behavior/issue:   EC card terminal does not respond
https://jira.si.siemens.cloud/browse/EVC3-9527
Workaround: systemctl restart sicharge-cp-ccv
Solution: Update to v9.X
